## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      3 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 05.08.2026 - 11.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Tony129837_, 05.08.2026, 4/5: "Really enjoy the app. There are things they could do to improve the app, features they could add. But if you’re looking for a simple, seamless app that tracks workouts, gives basic statistics, has a decent amount of exercise library, average customization…. Then this is the app for you. It is very smooth, always works and does not have bugs that I have seen. The team behind the app care and did a really good job. I don’t give out many 5 star reviews because I believe that means it can’t improve. 4 stars for a great app with room to grow. Excited to see what comes with future updates."
            2. _Frdiaz_, 05.08.2026, 4/5: "The app is amazing, and I am loving it as it has helped me with my health goals and improving my medical condition. It has become one of my favorite fitness apps because of how intuitive it is to track workouts, monitor progress, and stay consistent. The overall experience has been excellent, which is why I'm leaving such a high rating. The only issue I've been consistently experiencing is with syncing between my iPhone 17 Pro and my  Watch Series 11. Whenever I start a workout on my iPhone, the app automatically launches on my watch, which is great. However, as I track my workouts, I've encountered multiple instances where completing a set or rep on my watch does not sync to my iPhone, and vice versa. This results in different workout progress being displayed on each device. Another frustrating issue is that I often cannot finish a workout from my iPhone unless it is also completed on my watch. When I tap the Finish button on my iPhone, I frequently receive an error as if my Apple Watch is not nearby, even though I always make sure both devices remain in close proximity throughout my workout. I followed all of the troubleshooting steps suggested within the app, including deleting and reinstalling the app on both my iPhone and Apple Watch, but unfortunately the syncing issue still persists. Other than this synchronization problem, the app has been outstanding, and I genuinely enjoy using it every day. I'm hopeful this can be resolved because it's the only thing preventing an otherwise perfect experience. Has anyone else experienced this issue, or are there any additional troubleshooting steps or settings I should try to get the iPhone and Apple Watch to stay synchronized consistently?"
            3. _Maxrogall_, 11.08.2026, 5/5: "I’ve tried a few apps (including the ones by my gyms themselves) but most of them were buggy and did not offer the features Hevy does. Intuitive use, handy lock screen widget to check off sets without unlocking, nice integration of apps like Strava - it’s a 5/5 for me."
